translations.settings.title: Settings
translations.security.locked_hint: For security, please verify your identity
translations.security.title: Security Settings
translations.security.secure_delete_tip: When enabled, data is overwritten multiple times before deletion. Slower but harder to recover.
translations.security.crash_report_tip: When enabled, a sanitized report is generated on crash (no file paths or usernames). You can copy it to GitHub Issues to help diagnose. The report is stored locally and never uploaded automatically.
translations.security.need_at_least_one: At least one verification method must remain enabled.
translations.web.title: Web
translations.web.http_warning: ⚠️ Web uses plain HTTP. Use only on trusted LAN.
translations.web.loopback_warning:
⚠ No LAN IP detected (currently 127.0.0.1).
Other devices cannot access via QR code. Make sure this computer is on a LAN / Wi-Fi.
translations.web.https_tip: Encrypts traffic with a self-signed certificate to prevent sniffing on the LAN. The browser will warn about an untrusted certificate; just choose to continue.
translations.web.https_warning: 🔒 HTTPS is enabled (self-signed). Your browser may warn about the certificate; please choose to continue.
translations.web.https_restart_hint: Stop the service before changing the HTTPS setting.
translations.appearance.title: Appearance
translations.appearance.context_menu_tip:
When enabled, right-click any file in Windows Explorer
to quickly encrypt via "Encrypt this file (SecureVault)".

translations.language.restart_tip: Language changed. Some interfaces update on next start.
